in_sanskrit.name: Iyra
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nectar, Ambrosia
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Iyra एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Iyra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ayu' which means life. The suffix 'ra' is added to denote the nectar of life or ambrosia. Iyra is a name of the divine goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
